model_name: Stage-2 Cardiology Workup Ensemble (PLR+UniMP GAT-T + XGBoost + RF)

training_cohort.source: UCI 4-Center Cardiology Workup Cohort (Cleveland, Budapest, Zurich, VA Long Beach)

intended_use: Stage-2 Cardiology diagnostic escalation for patients deferred or flagged high-risk during Stage-1 primary-care screening. Incorporates ECG, stress-test heart rate, ST depression, chest pain, and perfusion scan biomarkers.
limitations: Trained on 918 retrospective cardiology referrals across 4 centers (Cleveland, Budapest, Zurich, VA Long Beach).
High pre-test referral prevalence (~55%); intended strictly for Stage-2 cardiology workup after primary-care triage.
Research decision-support prototype only; not FDA-cleared or CE-marked clinical diagnostic software.
